procure-bot: Containers: RTM-4421, RTM-4422. POs: PO-78201, PO-78202. Qty: 12 racks total. Status: HOLD (customs query).

sarah: Ops: can we partial-release at Rotterdam for SI pilot units?

omar: I'll call broker and ask about partial release. Also ask vendor for digital affidavit.
